name: B10-0327/2026 (ECR) – Deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It calls for the release of Aliaksandra Pulinovich, a young woman jailed for more than 10 years, and of all other political prisoners in Belarus. It condemns the Lukashenka regime's repression and the abuse of a criminal code article used to extend sentences. It asks the European Union and its member states to strengthen sanctions on those responsible.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only states demands and opinions.
- It affects Belarus's political prisoners and their families.
- Next, the resolution goes to EU institutions and member states.
